command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
SUBJECT=0cc37776a8f91a6c93c8828b5283f1762973ca48
ROOT=/workspace/t4-grid10-vps-a1
rm -rf "$ROOT"
git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein-2.0.git "$ROOT"
cd "$ROOT"
git checkout -q "$SUBJECT"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SUBJECT"
export F2_SUBJECT_SHA="$SUBJECT"
python3 - <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations
import base64, importlib.util, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
module_path = root / 'research/grid10_lab/grid10_fabric_lab.py'
assert module_path.is_file(), module_path
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('grid10_fabric_lab_vps_a1', module_path)
grid = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec and spec.loader
sys.modules[spec.name] = grid
spec.loader.exec_module(grid)

osr = {}
try:
    for line in pathlib.Path('/etc/os-release').read_text().splitlines():
        if '=' in line:
            k,v = line.split('=',1); osr[k] = v.strip().strip('\"')
except Exception:
    pass

CHILD = r'''
import importlib.util, inspect, json, pathlib, sys
module_path, db_path, action, payload_json = sys.argv[1:]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('grid10_fabric_lab_child', module_path)
grid = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[spec.name]=grid; spec.loader.exec_module(grid)
f = grid.Fabric(pathlib.Path(db_path)); p=json.loads(payload_json)
try:
    if action == 'claim':
        f.runtime_join(p['node_id'], p['capability'], p['pid'])
        f.runtime_claim_task(p['task_id'], p['node_id'], expected_epoch=p['expected_epoch'])
    elif action == 'join_claim_current':
        f.runtime_join(p['node_id'], p['capability'], p['pid']); s=f.snapshot(); f.runtime_claim_task(p['task_id'], p['node_id'], expected_epoch=s.epoch)
    elif action == 'join':
        f.runtime_join(p['node_id'], p['capability'], p['pid'])
    elif action == 'commit':
        kw=dict(lease=p['lease'], token=p['token'], packet=p['packet'], expected_epoch=p['expected_epoch'])
        if 'expected_digest' in inspect.signature(f.coordinator_commit).parameters: kw['expected_digest']=p['expected_digest']
        f.coordinator_commit(**kw)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(action)
    print(json.dumps({'ok': True}, sort_keys=True)); raise SystemExit(0)
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({'ok': False, 'type': type(e).__name__, 'error': str(e)}, sort_keys=True)); raise SystemExit(23)
'''

def child(db, action, payload):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',CHILD,str(module_path),str(db),action,json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='grid10-vps-a1-') as td:
    td = pathlib.Path(td); db = td/'fabric.sqlite3'; f = grid.Fabric(db)
    f.seed_scope('voice'); f.seed_task('t-cas','voice','reason',{'q':'collision'})
    s = f.snapshot()
    p1 = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c',CHILD,str(module_path),str(db),'claim',json.dumps({'node_id':'n1','capability':'reason','pid':1101,'task_id':'t-cas','expected_epoch':s.epoch},sort_keys=True)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    p2 = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c',CHILD,str(module_path),str(db),'claim',json.dumps({'node_id':'n2','capability':'reason','pid':1102,'task_id':'t-cas','expected_epoch':s.epoch},sort_keys=True)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    o1,e1=p1.communicate(timeout=30); o2,e2=p2.communicate(timeout=30)
    claims=[{'rc':p1.returncode,'out':o1.strip(),'err':e1.strip()},{'rc':p2.returncode,'out':o2.strip(),'err':e2.strip()}]
    success_count=sum(x['rc']==0 for x in claims)
    loser_errors=[json.loads(x['out']).get('error','') for x in claims if x['rc']!=0 and x['out'].strip().startswith('{')]
    cas_collision_pass = success_count == 1 and any(('TASK_CLAIM_CAS_FAILED' in x or 'TASK_NOT_CLAIMABLE' in x) for x in loser_errors)

    f.seed_task('t-restart','voice','reason',{'q':'restart'})
    c = child(db,'join_claim_current',{'node_id':'n3','capability':'reason','pid':1201,'task_id':'t-restart'})
    assert c.returncode == 0, c.stdout+c.stderr
    time.sleep(0.05)
    reclaimed=f.reclaim_stale_claims(stale_after_seconds=0.01)
    j=child(db,'join',{'node_id':'n3','capability':'reason','pid':2202}); assert j.returncode==0, j.stdout+j.stderr
    s2=f.snapshot(); f.runtime_claim_task('t-restart','n3',expected_epoch=s2.epoch)
    restart_rejoin_pass = reclaimed == ['t-restart']

    f.runtime_join('coord-a','reason',1301); f.runtime_join('coord-b','reason',1302)
    elected=f.elect_coordinator('voice',['coord-a','coord-b']); assert elected is not None
    lease,token=elected; snap=f.snapshot(); packet=grid.result_packet('coord-a',snap,'voice',{'task_id':'t-result','answer':42})
    cc=child(db,'commit',{'lease':lease,'token':token,'packet':packet,'expected_epoch':snap.epoch,'expected_digest':snap.state_digest}); assert cc.returncode==0, cc.stdout+cc.stderr
    restarted=grid.Fabric(db); snap2=restarted.snapshot(); duplicate_rejected=False
    try:
        import inspect
        kw=dict(lease=lease,token=token,packet=packet,expected_epoch=snap2.epoch)
        if 'expected_digest' in inspect.signature(restarted.coordinator_commit).parameters: kw['expected_digest']=snap2.state_digest
        restarted.coordinator_commit(**kw)
    except Exception as e:
        duplicate_rejected='DUPLICATE_RESULT_REJECTED' in str(e)

    con=grid.connect(db)
    try:
        integrity=con.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
        admitted=con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admitted_results').fetchone()[0]
        nodes=con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nodes').fetchone()[0]
        tasks=con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks').fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        con.close()

    receipt={
      'schema':'T4_GRID10_OWNER_VPS_MULTIPROCESS_S1_A1/v1',
      'result':'EXECUTED_NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE' if all([cas_collision_pass,restart_rejoin_pass,duplicate_rejected,integrity=='ok',admitted==1]) else 'EXECUTED_PRODUCT_NEGATIVE',
      'failure_class': None if all([cas_collision_pass,restart_rejoin_pass,duplicate_rejected,integrity=='ok',admitted==1]) else 'PRODUCT_NEGATIVE',
      'source':{'repository':'gschaidergabriel/frankenstein-2.0','f2_subject_sha':os.environ['F2_SUBJECT_SHA'],'module_path':'research/grid10_lab/grid10_fabric_lab.py'},
      'execution':{'surface':'OWNER_VPS_ROOTLESS_PODMAN_SANDBOX','os_release':osr,'python':sys.version.split()[0],'independent_os_processes_observed':True,'network_required':False},
      'observed':{'cas_collision_exactly_one_winner':cas_collision_pass,'restart_reclaim_rejoin':restart_rejoin_pass,'duplicate_commit_rejected_after_fresh_object_reopen':duplicate_rejected,'sqlite_integrity':integrity,'admitted_results':admitted,'nodes_seen':nodes,'tasks_seen':tasks,'claim_processes':claims},
      'promotion_candidate':{'owner_vps_grid10_lab_component_runtime':1 if all([cas_collision_pass,restart_rejoin_pass,duplicate_rejected,integrity=='ok',admitted==1]) else 0},
      'explicit_zero_credit':{'physical_grid10':0,'canonical_unifieddb_authority':0,'gwt_jspace':0,'effect':0,'voice':0,'training':0,'whole_product':0,'s2_nspawn':0,'physical_s4':0},
      'fidelity_note':'This is a bounded owner-VPS rootless-Podman laboratory execution. It is not physical GRID10 and does not claim S2/nspawn or canonical state authority.'
    }
    raw=json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
    print('T4_GRID10_VPS_RECEIPT_B64='+base64.b64encode(raw).decode())
    if receipt['result']!='EXECUTED_NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE': raise SystemExit(42)
PY
